name: Quiet Afternoon at Lark Street Studio (open hours)
summary: Monthly silent afternoon in a small yoga studio. Drop in any time between 2 and 5, sit, lie down, or walk the yard. Max 12. $10.
description:
QUIET AFTERNOON at Lark Street Studio
First Sunday of every month

We close the studio to classes on Sundays and open it once a month for a silent afternoon. Space for 12. No tradition, no teaching, no talking.

HOW IT WORKS
Doors open 2 to 5. Come when you like, leave when you like. Sit on a cushion or a chair, lie on a mat by the heater, walk the little yard out back. Stay forty minutes or the whole three hours. Nobody keeps track.

Silent the whole time. If you need something, Dana is in the side kitchen; there is a notepad. Tea available.

WHO IT'S FOR
Anyone. If you've never sat still on purpose for more than ten minutes, this is a low-stakes place to try it. Nobody is watching and you can leave whenever you want.
If something comes up and you want to talk about it, Dana is around after five.

COST
$10 in the jar. Nobody turned away.

WHAT TO BRING
Socks (concrete floor). A blanket if you run cold. Cushions, chairs, and mats are here.
practical: First Sunday monthly, 2 to 5pm, drop in. $10 suggested. 12 spots, first come. Cushions, chairs, mats provided. Two steps at the entrance, no ramp. Street parking. Tea.
